_comment: Extra Nepali slang for review sentiment. Score runs -1.0 (worst) to +1.0 (best); near 0 is neutral. SINGLE WORDS ONLY - the scorer matches word by word, so a phrase will never match. Add romanized and Devanagari as separate entries, and list spelling variants separately, since romanized Nepali is not standardised. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Test with:  python nepali_lexicon.py "your phrase here"
